Education and Research

# Fuel Academic Excellence with Real-World Media Intelligence

Give your students and faculty access to the same datasets by the Media Technology Monitor (MTM) that media experts, industry regulators and scholars have relied on for over two decades. Nationally representative, bilingual, and rigorous enough for peer review.

## Multiple datasets. Hundreds of research directions.

MTM tracks how Canadians consume media and technology across 5000+ variables — spanning platforms, behaviours, demographics, and devices. Browse by topic to find what your research needs.

Sports

Example

“What share of Canadians watched a live sporting event online last month?”

Variables available

Watched sports onlineSportsSVODESPN+TSN

Streaming

Example

“How does Twitch viewership differ between Teens and Gen Z Canadians?”

Variables available

Age 12 to 17Age 18 to 24Twitch

AI Tool Adoption

Example

“How rapidly has AI tool adoption grown among Canadians since 2023?”

Variables available

ChatGPTGeminiClaudeAge 18 to 24Grok

Gaming & Consoles

Example

“How does gaming device ownership vary across income levels in Canada?”

Variables available

Game console ownersNintendo SwitchPlayStationXBoxIncome

Language & Culture

Example

“How do media consumption patterns differ between English- and French-speaking Canadians?”

Variables available

AnglophoneFrancophoneSocial MediaLanguage spoken at HomeNewsTV hours

News Consumption

Example

“Are younger Canadians abandoning traditional news formats in favour of social media?”

Variables available

Read online newsNews consumption platformSocial mediaCTVYouTube

Over 5000+ variables available across 200+ topic areas, searchable and filterable in our tools.

## Powerful tools designed for serious inquiry

### Analytic Tools

Query MTM's full dataset by platform, region, language, and demographic. Build custom cross-tabs in minutes, track adoption curves over time, and model where your audience will be in three years — all at the click of a button.

Data Analysis

Trending

Forecasting

[Learn more](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/en/tools/analytic-tools/)

### Census Tools

### Census Tools

Map your audience at the postal code level. Identify underserved communities, size local markets, and benchmark your reach against the national population — all from a single dashboard sourced directly from Statistics Canada census data.

Snapshot

Explorer

Compare

3 more

## Gold standard research all of your research needs

We provide universities and colleges with the insights needed to drive innovation and learning across every specialization and at every stage of their academic journey.

01 For Students

Build Market-Ready Skills

Ground assignments in the most up-to-date research and build market-ready skills by navigating the same metrics and trends used by Canada’s top industry leaders and governmental institutions.

02 For Faculty

Enrich Course Curriculum

Enhance your curriculum with authentic, up-to-date reports and datasets that turn abstract concepts into tangible lessons.

03 For Research Projects

Power Serious Academic Inquiry

Support your research in the country's most robust longitudinal media studies, ensuring your findings are both current and credible.

## MTM in Action for Educators

Learn how the MTM offers essential content and tools for professors and students alike

<!-- Card 1 -->

Use Case

A professor is looking for a historical and current data on the state of broadcast TV when developing a new curriculum.

TV viewershipTV hoursRegionAge

How to leverage this

Examine usage of linear TV and channels across a wide range of demographics via the Data Analysis Tool, or read the TV distribution report for a broader overview.

<!-- Card 2 -->

Use Case

A student writing a masters thesis on different locations for data centres across different communities.

MunicipalitiesPostal CodeAgeIncome

How to leverage this

Leverage the Compare feature in the Census Tool for a granular look at different prospective locations.

## What academic institutions are saying about us

![University of Ottawa](https://aishwaryabhattbhatt-cbc.github.io/mtm-website-4/images/home/solutions/logos/education/uOttawa.svg)

As the author of nine editions of a Canadian Advertising textbook, I have included data from Media Technology Monitor (MTM) for the past five editions to enhance the Broadcast, Internet and Social Media Chapters. I believe the data improved the quality allowing students to understand the complexities of advertising planning decisions. The textbook contains the most current consumer media technology usage and adoption data to keep it in a leading market position. MTM is a wonderful partner and I look forward to working with them for the next edition.

Michael Guolla, Professor, University of Ottawa
